---
title: "Testing"
teaching: 45
exercises: 15
---

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: questions

- How do you ensure your code does what you think it does?
- How does testing help maintain reproducible workflows?

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: objectives

- Explain benefits of automated testing
- Write structured unit tests using the `testthat` package
- Organise tests using standard project structure

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: keypoints

- Automated tests increase confidence in your code.
- Tests support reproducibility.
- `testthat` provides a structured framework for testing.

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
